mod.overview: VX "-Tribute-" is built on the VX5 Infinite scripts (no ammo items, energy-fed weapons) but brings back VX5's mode switching. Admins can run it as VX5, OGL, NOTOR, or new VXU and VXO "-Tribute-" profiles, with the Defaults/MEDIUM/HARD difficulty files. It restores the full-power, Energy-Pack-only Laser Rifle. Repair Kits and the Grenade air brake / Beacon speed boost are unlimited by default, behind server switches.
notes: Profiles (vxmod.cs vxmode): "Ultra_RenegadesVX5 -Tribute-" (default, execs UltraVX5.cs), "Ultra_RenegadesVX5_OGL", "Ultra_RenegadesVX5_NOTOR", "Ultra_RenegadesVXU -Tribute-" (UltraVXU.cs) and "Ultra_RenegadesVXO -Tribute-" (UltraVXO.cs). Each profile sets its own spawn kit, shop lists and team limits; VXU and VXO take the LiL Rocket and EMP Rocket launchers out of the shop.

Difficulty modes are back: server start calls vxmode() and vxDIFmode(), and "Defaults" execs UltraVX5_EASY.cs, which sets projectile damage and item limits at mission start. MEDIUM and HARD raise armor health (HARD: light 1.2, medium 2.2, heavy 3.2) and cut weapon damage. Infinite and Hunter had no difficulty files. Mod voting is on and difficulty voting off by default (server.cs). UltraVX5_EASY.cs never sets armor maxDamage, so after switching from MEDIUM or HARD back to Defaults the raised armor health stays until the server restarts.

Switches set by the start-up script when the host has not set them: $UnlimitedBoostBrake true and $UnlimitedRepairKits true (game.cs also sets the latter true). Admins can switch Boosts/Brakes between infinite and non-infinite from the Tab menu.
$AdminViewPM true copies every private message to super admins (comchat.cs).
Hand-item limits are VX5's again (light armor: 35 Mines, Grenades and Beacons; Infinite allowed 1). Weapons still need no ammo, and the ammunition items are still absent.

LaserRifle.summary: The full VX5 Laser Rifle again: a hard-hitting beam that draws a large chunk of energy per shot and only works with an Energy Pack.
notes: Unlike Infinite, LaserRifleImage draws 10 to 20 energy per shot (Infinite: at most 0.1) with a 0.05 s reload. Laser damage is energy drawn times sniperLaser's damageConversion 0.7, so a shot hits roughly 200 times harder than Infinite's.
LaserRifle::onUse is back: without an Energy Pack mounted it refuses with "Must have an Energy Pack to use Laser Rifle."
Laser hits to the head do 30% extra.

LiLRocketLauncher.summary: VX5's LiL Rocket Launcher with unlimited rockets: three homing rockets at a locked player or flier within 350 m, or one fast straight rocket otherwise.
notes: onFire again calls Player::decItemCount on $WeaponAmmo[LiLRocketLauncher], but that table entry is set to "" in item.cs. The call removes nothing and the launcher stays unlimited.
The difficulty files set the rockets' damage (Defaults: LiLRocketEMP 0.3, LiLRocket and LiLRocketSubmission 1, LiLRocketalt 2; HARD: 0.2 each).
Not in the shop under the VXU and VXO profiles.
LiLRocketLauncher.source: item.cs LiLRocketLauncherImage::onFire, $WeaponAmmo; UltraVX5_EASY.cs; UltraVX5_HARD.cs; UltraVXU.cs; UltraVXO.cs

LiLEMPRocketLauncher.summary: VX5's EMP rocket launcher with unlimited rockets: two homing EMP rockets at a locked target within 350 m, or one straight EMP rocket otherwise.
notes: onFire again calls decItemCount on $WeaponAmmo[LiLEMPRocketLauncher], which is "", so nothing is removed.
An EMP hit zeroes the victim's energy, sets recharge to 6 and drops their weapon, pack and flag.
Not in the shop under the VXU and VXO profiles.
LiLEMPRocketLauncher.source: item.cs LiLEMPRocketLauncherImage::onFire; player.cs Player::onDamage; UltraVXU.cs; UltraVXO.cs

RepairKit.summary: Repairs almost all damage. Unlimited by default; the server switch $UnlimitedRepairKits makes kits consumable again.
notes: onUse removes the kit only when $UnlimitedRepairKits is false. It is true by default and has no Tab-menu toggle.
Heals 0.99 damage. Armors carry 1 kit.

Grenade.summary: Air brake: using a grenade slows you down. How much depends on the active profile. Unlimited unless admins turn infinite Boosts/Brakes off.
notes: When $UnlimitedBoostBrake is false, each use removes a grenade.
Default profile: your velocity is divided by 6, as in Infinite.

VXU profile: velocity is multiplied by $VXU::BrakeSpeed (-0.1), which reverses you slightly. VXO profile: multiplied by $VXO::BrakeSpeed (0), a dead stop. Both print "Impulse Brake Activated." and also throw a LiLBoost mine (no damage, kickback 113).
Grenade.source: item.cs Grenade::onUse, Brake::UpdateVel; ArmorData.cs $VXU::BrakeSpeed, $VXO::BrakeSpeed; Mine.cs lilBoost

Beacon.summary: Speed booster. In the default profile it drops a Boost mine at your feet whose blast throws you; in VXU and VXO it multiplies your speed directly. Unlimited unless admins turn infinite Boosts/Brakes off.
notes: When $UnlimitedBoostBrake is false, each use removes a beacon. The removal happens before the 0.2 s throw cooldown check, so a press during the cooldown still uses one up.
Default profile: throws a Boost mine (no damage, kickback 500) at your feet. Unlike Infinite, the leftover call to the undefined Beacon::deployShape is gone.

VXU and VXO: Boost::UpdateVel scales your velocity by BoostSpeed (VXU 3.0, VXO 4.5), reduced by how close your x-speed already is to $SpeedMax (200). It keeps your current speed instead if scaling would slow you down. It prints "You use a Speed Booster." and throws a LiLBoost mine.
Beacon.source: item.cs Beacon::onUse, Boost::UpdateVel, SpeedCompare; ArmorData.cs; Mine.cs Boost, lilBoost
